$comment: The implementer's settings, passed to claude-code-action via the settings input. Registers the read-confinement hook (see read-confinement.settings.json) and a pre-push guard that refuses a push changing .github/workflows or .github/actions. The workflow stages both scripts and this file to $RUNNER_TEMP/read-confinement/ before the agent starts, outside the workspace, and runs the staged copies. Each command ends in `|| exit 2`: a hook that crashes is a non-blocking error in Claude Code, so any failure to decide must block the call instead. See .github/agent-runtime/guard-implementer-push.mjs.
